m: प्राह् (प्र-√ अह्), only pf. प्राह, to announce, declare, utter, express, say, tell (with dat. or acc. of pers. and acc. of thing), ŚBr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.; to record, hand down by tradition, ŚBr.; (with 2 acc.) to call, name, regard or consider as, Mn.; MBh. &c.
